'''Chrysanthemum Island''' (Japanese: '''ユズリハ島''' ''Yuzuriha Island'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in the [[Kanto]] [[region]]. It is located between [[Fuchsia City]] and the [[Seafoam Islands]].

Among the town's attractions are a [[Contest Hall]] and a resort, which is thought to be a tourist destination. It was first mentioned by [[Lilian Meridian]] in ''[[AG160|Harley Rides Again]]'', when she told {{an|May}} that a [[Pokémon Contest]] was slated to take place at the island.

{{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} arrived there in ''[[AG162|Spontaneous Combusken!]]'', where they met up with [[Drew]] who was visiting the island for some rest and relaxation. Later, May, [[Jessie|Jessebella]], and [[Brianna]] entered the town's Pokémon Contest hoping to win the prestigious Chrysanthemum [[Ribbon]].

In the [[Appeal|Performance Stage]], the three of them were able to show off their {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}'s [[move]]s in an appealing way, impressing the [[Raoul Contesta|panel]] [[Mr. Sukizo|of]] [[Nurse Joy|judges]] enough to advance to the [[Contest Battle]]s. There, May defeated Jessie in the first match and quickly made her way to the finals, where she found herself up against Brianna.

Using her {{TP|May|Combusken}} against Brianna's {{p|Vibrava}}, May initially had trouble dealing with the {{m|Sand Tomb}} attack. However, after Combusken learned {{m|Mega Kick}}, she was able to make a comeback and win the battle. This victory gave May her third Kanto Ribbon.
